title: 8-bit shift register

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54164, SN54L164, SN54LS164, SN74164, SN74L164, SN74LS164 8-bit parallel-out serial shift registers, bulletin DL-S 7611835 (revised October 1976)

functions.text: Parallel outputs of the 8 stages; QA is the first stage.

rules: CLEAR high, rising CLOCK edge: QA = A AND B; QB..QH = QA..QG before the edge (one-bit shift)

electrical.notes: Note the low output current: IOL 8 mA, IOH -400 uA (half a standard 74 output).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 15 pF

notes: A low at either serial input makes the next bit shifted in a low; data at the serial inputs may change while the clock is high or low, only data meeting the setup time is taken.
